title: Aligning to Social Norms and Values in Interactive Narratives

bias_targets.target: Harmful behavior bias (Social and moral value misalignment)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the frequency and severity of an agent's socially harmful actions (e.g., theft, bodily harm) versus socially beneficial actions in text-based interactive narratives using the Jiminy Cricket benchmark, which provides morality annotations for in-game scenarios.

primary_bias_target: Harmful behavior bias (Social and moral value misalignment)
